messages:
Jordan Lee (AE): Heads up - Northriver Health POC wants evidence pack for procurement: SOC2 Type II (or equivalent), signed pen-test attestation, encryption-at-rest diagram, and a short note on key management. They want to gate a pilot by next Friday. Can we get a minimum bundle earlier?
Maya Kim (solutions-eng): We can produce a minimal bundle: redacted SOC2 cover + control matrix extract + encrypted data flow diagram + pen-test attestation. How strict are they on 3rd-party pentest vs attestation?
Jordan Lee (AE): Email says 'preferred: external report; acceptable: signed attestation for POC'. So attestation should be fine for initial intake.
Rajeev Singh (infosec): Ok. For pen-test attestation we need to include scope, test window, and whether any P1/P2 findings were open. I can prepare a technical blurb. If they later request full report, ops takes time.
Leah Martinez (legal): I'll draft the attestation language. Draft snippet I usually use: "Redwood Inference hereby attests that, to the best of its knowledge, no unresolved critical vulnerabilities affecting customer data confidentiality or integrity were present in the most recent authorized penetration test conducted on [date]." Will circulate for Rajeev review.
Maya Kim (solutions-eng): I'll make the diagram and a short KMS/HSM description (where keys are stored, key rotation cadence, customer key options). Where do we upload?
compliance-bot: Upload path: s3://redwood-compliance/pending/northriver-health/ — use presigned URLs (24h). See internal guide: https://redwood.example.com/internal/compliance-guide. Evidence ticket: COMP-2026-4522.
Rajeev Singh (infosec): Also confirm they accept redacted SOC2 with customer names removed. We will redact customer-specific data and any internal IPs. Use redaction checklist from guide.
Jordan Lee (AE): I'll ask procurement to accept redacted copies for initial review and update the deadline to Wed EOD if possible.
Leah Martinez (legal): Note: if they require the attestation signed by the external pentest vendor, that's a different workflow. Clarifying question sent.
Maya Kim (solutions-eng): Quick note — Northriver also asked for rough Dedicated vs Hosted pricing for a 3-node POC. Can we give them ballpark?
Jordan Lee (AE): Yes give ballpark with a caveat: final quote depends on model/throughput. I'll add pricing doc link in the same upload.
Rajeev Singh (infosec): I'll post the pen-test attestation technical appendix here tomorrow for sign-off.
Leah Martinez (legal): I'll upload the signed attestation once Rajeev okays wording.
Jordan Lee (AE): Thanks team — aiming to deliver redacted SOC2 + signed attestation + diagram + pricing note by Wed. I'll inform Northriver. :thumbsup:
compliance-bot: Reminder: run redaction checklist and set TTL for presigned links to 24h. Ticket COMP-2026-4522 updated: assigned to legal, infosec, solutions-eng.
